title: Workspace sweep: extension-server demo_next_id len()-based collision after delete in chat-server and calendars-server
description:
Sweep the extension-server siblings' MemoryBackend demo_next_id helpers for the len()-based id collision bug fixed in bd:JMAP-qz9v.14 (jmap-contacts-server).

Currently affected (verified via grep):
- crate-jmap-calendars-server/src/memory.rs:340 (m.len() at :370, debug_assert at :376)
- crate-jmap-chat-server/src/memory.rs:200 (m.len() at :230, debug_assert at :236)

Mail-server already uses the timestamp+atomic counter pattern (its 'realistic-demo-ids' mode equivalent) and is not affected. Other extension-server siblings (tasks/filenode/sharing/metadata) need a grep to confirm.

Fix: mirror the contacts-server approach — add a per-(type, account) monotonic counter to Inner (feature-gated to non-realistic-demo-ids mode) and increment it on every mint, never decrementing on delete. Add 3 tests (id_not_recycled_after_destroy, id_namespace_is_per_type_and_account, ids_are_monotonic_within_namespace) mirroring contacts-server's demo_id_tests module.

Cross-reference contacts implementation: commit landing bd:JMAP-qz9v.14.
close_reason: Moot: the id counters it concerned were removed in 2a8bf0aa (JMAP-3t94.5). CI green at 8e240e18 (stable+beta 3502 passed).
